name: Q3-full-delta0.2
definition: flat Stage-0 action on a D = 4 heavy state (u = m_flat^-2-normalised, y = u p^2): FF = int_0^1 psi2(p) (2 - y) D_h dp + s u int_0^1 psi3(p) D_h dp + a (2J(J+1) - c4 + s) u^3 - 2 c u^2, D_++ = P_J(1 - 2y), D_+- = P^(0,8)_(J-4)(1 - 2y), (s, c4) = (+1, 1) for ++ and (-1, 41) for +-; Stage-0 norm N = |B2| + |B3| + |FW| + 2 c u^2; psi2, psi3 polynomials in p (lowest power first, IEEE doubles given as repr strings = exact binary values); A = 2 psi2'(0); upper end 2L = A log(2Lam/3) + B_eff
